description: This Java class implements a complex sessionization example using Apache Spark Structured Streaming. It processes streaming event data to identify user sessions based on event types and timing conditions, demonstrating advanced stateful stream processing with custom session merging and eviction logic.

classes.name: Sessions
classes.description: Holds a list of user session accumulations, ensuring they are sorted by start time.

classes.name: EventTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of event types: NEW_EVENT and CLOSE_SESSION.

classes.name: SessionEvent
classes.description: Represents an individual event with user ID, event type, start and end timestamps.

classes.name: SessionAcc
classes.description: Accumulates events into a user session, ensuring correct ordering and placement of CLOSE_SESSION events.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a finalized user session with ID, duration, and number of events.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Sets up Spark streaming context, reads streaming data, processes it into sessions, and outputs session summaries.

methods.name: handleEvict
methods.description: Handles eviction of expired sessions based on watermark, returning evicted sessions.

methods.name: mergeSessions
methods.description: Merges overlapping or contiguous sessions, respecting CLOSE_SESSION events, and updates state.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create new instances of Sessions, SessionEvent, SessionAcc, and Session.
